summary.headline: Treya Partners uncovers $2.27 M in annual savings for FreshEdge across 8 indirect spend categories
summary.narrative: Through a multi-wave sourcing program, Treya Partners identified $2.27 million in annual savings for FreshEdge, with initial contracts already executed for utilities and crates & pallets. Major wins include a $1.56 M packaging / corrugate opportunity now awaiting final signature and a nationwide fuel program in implementation. Additional workstreams in utilities and payment cards are moving toward completion, while waste management savings are on temporary hold pending client timing.
